reviews.outcome: Finite Boolean model families are Horn definable exactly when closed under binary/nonempty intersections. The corpus already proves necessity. For the converse use explicit separating rules: for a rejected true set X, if no permitted model extends X use X⇒bottom; otherwise intersect all permitted extensions and choose an atom in that intersection outside X. This explicitly handles empty model families and avoids ambiguity in the source’s compressed empty-intersection case. Definite Horn additionally requires the all-true valuation. Complexity/learning/basis and tightest-approximation developments are not selected.
